Orpheus

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Can you designate the present owner of the Territoty as his new owner ?

Disputed Territory [Jyhad, V:TES, Sabbat, SW, FN, CE]
Cardtype: Political Action

Political Card - Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1 stealth.
Choose a location and a Methuselah. Successful referendum means the chosen
Methuselah takes control of the chosen location.

From card text, I do not see any reason why you cannot. So yes, you can
designate the present owner as the new owner.

An interesting follow-up question is that, assuming that this is allowed, is
there a period of time between a player losing control of a location and
regaining control? For example, if your prey has 4 pool and the High Museum of
Art and you Dispute the Territory to your prey again, is there a brief period
of time between losing control of the location and regaining control where his
pool will drop to 0 and he will be ousted? I do not think so but I just want to
confirm. Thanks!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
> Can you designate the present owner of the Territoty as his new owner ?

Yes. Useful for passing votes (Voter Captivation, Cryptic Rider) or for
just "sucking up" an lingering auto-pass that you don't want to hand to
the rest of the table (Charming Lobby), but not for moving locquipment
from one minion you control to another (since control of the locquipment
didn't actually change).

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>anyway: I see a similar question: if you control Succubuc Club, and
>you trade someone's Haven Uncovered, can you put it on a different
>minion?

No. The HU remains where it is. The only relevancy is who controls it. So if
someone about to be ousted gives his HU to someone else, the card won't be
burned when the original controller is ousted.

>And consequently : how about Blood Dolls, The Rack and stuff?(would
>provide us with a funny way to move the rack between our own minions
>:-)

Blood Doll will not move. In addition, since Blood Doll has specific text
allowing the controller of the minion to use it, once again, the controller of
the Blood Doll is only important if he/she is about to be ousted (cause then
it'll burn).

If Disputed Territory is played on the Rack, you simply choose a ready vamp as
the text indicates.

Halcyan 2
